basis: Existing reviewed Coconut CSV and explicit user corrections; this is a project glossary, not an official rules document.

terms.fr: carte du dessus de votre pioche

review_rules: Preserve the actor and target: chosen character is not necessarily the character just played.
All characters includes opposing characters; do not replace it with your characters.
Preserve who draws a card, pronouns such as this/that, quantities, costs, zones, timing and optional effects.
Keep source rules symbols as named markers; cost and ink are distinct symbols.
Use existing supported **keyword** markup for game keywords, with punctuation outside the stars.
Official card names may be used only when supplied by the selected FR association; otherwise report uncertainty.
These examples guide wording, not game mechanics. Never substitute an existing card's effect for the photographed Coconut effect.
